capabilities: Generate images from a prompt on the local GPU
Send prompts to a local A1111-compatible image server
Run ComfyUI workflows to generate, edit or upscale
Save results as attachments or as a note with the recipe
extras: Model files (SD-Turbo ≈ 2.6 GB, SDXL-Turbo ≈ 7.1 GB) are downloaded only when the user clicks Download, checksum-verified, and stored in Obsidian's Cache API outside the vault. Built-in, Server and ComfyUI modes need desktop Obsidian; mobile works only through Image Playground on iOS/macOS 26+ with Apple Intelligence. The plugin also exposes a generation API to other plugins.
problem: Image generation normally means a cloud service and an account, so prompts and images leave the machine and results are not saved into the vault.

relations.evidence: a local image server you run yourself — Draw Things, AUTOMATIC1111, Forge, or SD.Next
AUTOMATIC1111 (stable-diffusion-webui): Launch it with the --api flag
point it at your own running ComfyUI server and a vault folder of workflows you exported in the API format
Runs entirely on-device through Apple's Image Playground via a Shortcut you install once

requires.name: Draw Things, AUTOMATIC1111, Forge or SD.Next server

summary: Image generator that runs SD-Turbo on your GPU inside Obsidian, or connects to a local Draw Things/A1111/ComfyUI server, saving results as attachments.
